name: union_null_composite_arm_stays_fallback
description: FALLBACK-BOUNDARY GUARD (family: union_null_composite_arm). A JSON null against a NON-NULLABLE union with a COMPOSITE arm: string | list<int>. BAML has no null fast path here (try_cast_union's optional exit does not apply), so coerce_union runs the null through every arm — and the LIST arm SURVIVES it (SingleToArray wraps the null, the element fails as ArrayItemParseError, and the arm succeeds as []). A map arm would likewise yield {} and an all-defaultable class arm its defaults. Native cannot claim 'non-nullable union rejects null' for such a union, so it DECLINES; the claimed error is kept only for an all-NON-COMPOSITE-leaf union where every arm provably fails. This locks that boundary: native must keep falling back while BAML claims. want live-captured from BAML v0.223 final parse.
